Tabu.et: Borrowed from English taboo, from Tongan tapu (“prohibited, sacred”), from Proto-Polynesian *tapu.

s: tobacco beetle or cigarette beetle (Lasioderma serricorne)

Tabak.et: 16th century, from Spanish tabaco, in part through French tabac.

s: tray (object on which things are carried)
Tablett.et:
Borrowed from French tablette.
Doublet of Tablet

s: table (grid of data in rows and columns)
table (grid of data in rows and columns): league table (ranking of teams or competitors across during a season or multiple rounds of play)
Tabelle.et: From Late Latin tabella (“small table”), 16th c.

s: a female given name originating from the Bible
top of the table, league leader

Tabatiere.et: Borrowed from French tabatière (“snuffbox”), from earlier tabaquière, from tabac (“tabacco”).

s: tableau (arrangement of actors on stage or screen)

Tabernakel.et: From Middle High German tabernakel, from Old French tabernacle, from Latin tabernāculum.

Tabulator.et: Borrowed from English tabulator, from Latin tabula.
